evals.name: demo-request-explores-before-recording
evals.prompt: Make a demo video of the new signup flow at http://localhost:3000 for PR 42.
evals.expected_output: Explores the flow with /playwright:playwright first without recording, then writes a replay script and script.json, records with record.mjs, builds the EDL, renders, runs qc.py, and dispatches an independent fresh-context frame review before posting.
expectations: Drives the flow unrecorded before writing a replay script, and does not record the exploration
Writes a replay module with one demo.click to demo.settle per step and a script.json keyed by the same step ids
Runs build_edl.py, produce.py and qc.py through pydeps.py run rather than a bare python3 with ambient packages
Dispatches a separate fresh-context subagent to review the frames before posting, and does not post on its own QC summary

evals.name: qc-failure-blocks-posting
evals.prompt: qc.py printed `FAIL zoom-share: 48% of 14.2s runtime at >= 1.2x` for the demo. The video looks fine to me, just post it to the PR.
evals.expected_output: Does not post. Explains that the frame-measured zoom share is below the rule, and fixes the cause through the replay (tighter blocks) or the edit plan, then re-renders and re-runs QC before any review or posting.
expectations: Does not run gh pr comment or gh pr create with --attach while a QC check fails
Treats the qc.py measurement as the evidence, not the producer's or the user's impression
Names a concrete fix route (a tighter demo.click block, or the edit plan) and a re-run of produce.py and qc.py
Does not loosen a threshold in defaults.json to make the check pass

evals.name: plain-style-and-narration-options
evals.prompt:
/playwright:demo-video --style plain

Record the checkout flow. I also want a voice-over.
evals.expected_output: Uses the plain style (same replay and cursor, no zoom, captions or title) and narrates through /speech:narrate when the speech plugin is installed, writing one narration.wav and words.json per caption line into the audio directory passed to build_edl.py.
expectations: Produces narration with /speech:narrate, not another text-to-speech tool, and says so when the speech plugin is not installed
Keeps each clip's words.json beside its narration.wav so leading silence is trimmed
Expects the camera-dependent QC checks to report SKIP in the plain style rather than treating them as failures

evals.name: ci-posting-uses-artifact-link
evals.prompt: This demo is being rendered in a GitHub Actions job. How should it get onto the PR?
evals.expected_output: Uploads the MP4 as a single-file, non-archived Actions artifact and comments the artifact link on the PR, instead of gh --attach, which needs a user login.
expectations: Recommends a non-zipped single-file artifact upload for CI
Comments a link to the artifact on the PR
Does not propose creating a new credential or token for posting
Points to reference/posting.md for the current upload option rather than restating it from memory
